title: Pip and the Jam
note: b413 — Learning — Phase 3, zz, qu, ch added, 32-sound stage.

pages.brief: Pip the sparrow standing on a puddled garden path after rain.
Pip the sparrow standing beside a small clay pot left on the path.
A close view into the clay pot, showing a bright red jam inside.
Pip the sparrow leaning down to peck at the red jam in the pot.
Pip the sparrow pulling back with bright red jam stuck all over his beak, looking surprised.
Pip the sparrow tapping his jammy beak against a rough doormat on the path.
Pip the sparrow with a clean beak now, a smear of red jam left on the mat.
Pip the sparrow happily pecking at the pot of red jam again on the path.
